feature_contract.goal: Translate actual game-authored D3D9 SM3 VS/PS SINCOS and vertex-only SGN into the native D3D11 HLSL shader generation and live Draw/DrawIndexed path, with conservative TEMP read/write accounting and original D3D9/DX9Ex input and FFB fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Decode VS3/PS3 SINCOS and VS3 SGN and emit native HLSL sin/cos/sign arithmetic with supported destination masks through the existing live D3D11 GPU draw path.

Validate SINCOS angle swizzle, reject undefined output channels, reject SGN scratch alias/invalid TEMP registers, invalidate SGN scratch lanes for later reads, and retain original D3D9 rendering/input/FFB on unsupported combinations.
DX11 Fast, Backend Conversion, Win32 Build, OpenXR and HUD Inspector conclude success on the same validation-bearing SHA; actual Quest3/VDXR gameplay evidence is separately untested.

integration_path: Decode intercepted game D3D9 SM3 SINCOS/SGN operations into native shader instructions
Generate native GPU HLSL sin/cos/sign with source swizzle, destination mask, and SGN TEMP scratch lifetime validation
Route supported shader pairs through live D3D11 Draw/DrawIndexed with original D3D9/DX9Ex render/input/FFB fallback for unsupported states
